overview.description: The Simplify Intermediate Term Treasury Futures Strategy ETF (TYA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in global macro alternatives. The fund seeks to match or outperform a US Treasury 20+ year index for a calendar quarter. The portfolio utilizes futures, call, and put options on US Treasury futures, ETFs, and government securities. TYA was launched on Sep 27, 2021 and is issued by Simplify.
